_what_this_is: A machine-readable map of the Sheerline tree and how its documents depend on each other. Change one document, and this graph names which others may now be stale. Adapted from releases/open-source/keel/os/dependency-graph.template.json.
_path_convention: Node keys and depends_on edges are sheerline-root-relative. External references (the corpus, the ratified fundamentals docs, keel) are named in each node's description, not as edges, since they are not nodes in this graph.

meta.note: document_count equals the number of entries in 'nodes'.

clusters.corrections: The corrections convention slot (runtime is heyhi-mcp, Phase 2)
clusters.skills: The skills layer (registry engine reused from keel)
clusters.docs: The docs/ architecture walkthrough + diagram set
clusters.seminar: The novice-to-SME seminar curriculum (spine + 5 tracks / 21 modules)
clusters.studio: The Wheelhouse: the simulated prototype UI over the harness (D-08)
